decisions.why: Round 2's item is fixed: the stale 'GROW_GAP (6 px)' is gone (grep finds neither GROW_GAP nor '6 px' in plan.md, tasks.md or growth.py); the line now points at grow_gap, a corridor's whole strip plus 2 px. FR-004 as written.

decisions.summary: Standing footprint: envelope, wood seats, the yard's and beds' south reach + SUN_CORRIDOR_FT + 2 ft, the path out as grow_gap; the new household's reach its envelope ROLLED AT THE SEAT with the largest house (settled_seat), moved out until it clears, claimed to hold every household's envelope there
decisions.why: The standing side and the settle mechanism are as round 2 asked, and test_growth.py holds the move and the drop. But the plan's premise - 'the largest house's envelope at a seat holds every household's envelope there', so 'every seat offered clears the standing footprint by its OWN envelope there' - is false when measured. reach_at (growth.py:140) calls _bundle_envelope outside the placer, where _household_fixtures, _household_byre and _household_well are unset; household_parts (rolling/lot.py:174-176) sets them only inside try_place, and _bundle_template lays them inside the bbox. So the seat is spaced without the household's privy, manure pile, woodpile, persimmon, coop, byre and well pocket, while the standing footprint (its geom bbox) carries them. Measured here (observed 2026-10-02, method: a scratch harness wrapping s.try_place on the clone's engine, reference Inashiro form, 40 households, seeds 1, 3, 4, 8, 13, 25; each grown placement's drawn bbox reach from its house against reach_at at the seat offered): 240 of 302 grown placements exceed it, worst by 35.9 px north, 26.3 south, 8.3 west and 7.3 east; the drivers are the fixtures (seed 1: manure, privy, woodpile and persimmon reaching 34-51 px north against a 28 px reach). FR-004's 'never closer than FR-003's distance' is unmet, as in round 2, by a different cause. Fix: lay the reach at the seat with the next household's OWN parts - its lot k (the plain houses standing) is known at seat order, so set household_parts for that seat (or the byre, well and fixtures_of(k)) around the _bundle_envelope call and take them down after, or take the union over every part set the lots can carry - then re-measure and record in research.md that no grown placement's drawn envelope exceeds the reach its seat was spaced for.
